_comment: Copy this file to config.json (in the same directory) to customize combine_prayer_times.py without passing CLI flags on every run. CLI flags take precedence over config.json when explicitly provided.
_comment_patterns: no_suffix_patterns is a list of regex strings (or a single string). Any prayer row whose original 'desc' matches one of these regexes will NOT have '(ספרדי)' / '(אשכנזי)' appended.
_comment_headers: report_title, report_subtitle, and report_footer customize the HTML report header and footer. Leave null to use the default values (shul_name / page_date / last-updated timestamp), set to a non-empty string to override (supports luah #TAGs such as '#HEBDATE', '#PARSHA', '#SHABBOS-30' when luah_suite_path is configured, plus '{updated_at}' in report_footer), or set to '' (empty string) to hide.
_comment_luah_libs: luah_suite_path points to the shul-luah root folder ('..' relative to mg_sync/) containing 'pyzmanim-lib/' and 'luah_signage/'. You can also override pyzmanim_lib_path / luah_signage_path individually. If left null or not found on disk, #TAGs in report_* fields and extra_tables are left untouched as-is.
_comment_extra_tables: extra_tables optionally appends custom cards to the HTML reports: [{"title": "זמני היום — #PARSHA", "rows": [["#SUNRISE", "הנץ החמה"], ["#SUNSET", "שקיעה"], ["", "#MOLAD"]]}]. Titles, times, and descriptions all support #TAGs. Each table also accepts an optional "mode": "all" (default) | "both" | "chol" | "shabbos".
_comment_groups: chol_groups and shabbos_groups collapse matching timed rows in the HTML report into compact comma-separated lists: [["שחרית:", ".*שחרית.*"], ["מנחה:", "^(?!.*(?:ערבית|שישי)).*(?:מנחה|אשרי).*"]]. group_unmatched_order controls unmatched rows ('chronological' keeps them in place; 'below' places them below all matched groups). group_no_suffix_label controls labels on grouped rows that matched no_suffix_patterns: 'pattern' trims regex signs from the matched pattern (e.g. '.*המדרש.*' -> '20:15 (המדרש)'), null/'' omits the label ('20:15'), 'minyan' keeps the minyan label, or any custom string uses that fixed label.
_comment_group_unmatched_order_choices: 'chronological' (default; unmatched rows stay in place) | 'below' (all groups first, unmatched rows below).
_comment_group_no_suffix_label_choices: 'pattern' (default; label trimmed from the matched no_suffix_patterns regex) | 'minyan' (the row's minyan label) | null / '' / 'none' (no label) | any other string (used as a fixed label).
_comment_order_choices: 'chronological' (default; Erev Shabbos rows before Shabbos morning, timeless rows stay attached to the row above) | 'time' (plain HH:MM sort) | 'concat' (Sephardi rows then Ashkenazi rows).
_comment_single_row_label_style_choices: Minyan label of ungrouped single-row entries when grouping is on: 'inline' (default; in the title with parentheses) | 'below_time' (under the time, timed entries only) | 'below_all' (also under titles that have no time).
